start.text: Report sent. Marta's laptop is unplugged, and the files are locked. But this works by speed, and it might still be spreading.
start.name: Joshua

A.text: Joshua, I read your report. The server is safe for now. But this kind of program works by speed: so many files, so fast. Tonight we watch every file change.
A.name: Carla

B.text: A person changes a few files a minute. A program changes hundreds. And locked files get a new ending, like .locked.
B.name: Carla

C1.text: By the program and the hour. The Backup Agent is approved and copies many files at once. That is its job. An attack comes from a program nobody approved.
C1.name: Carla

C2.text: No. Paying promises nothing, and it pays for the next attack. We watch, and we find it by its name.
C2.name: Carla

D.text: The rules are in the [b][color=green]rulebook[/color][/b]. [b][color=red]Report[/color][/b] a change that breaks one. Let the rest [b][color=green]pass[/color][/b].
D.name: Carla

E.text: One change at a time. Many files is not always bad, so I'll check every rule.
E.name: Joshua
